summary: Completed backend + frontend verification for bank-prints removal and ERP Health Report read-only workflow on public URL. Required APIs and UI flows are working, and no data mutation was observed in tested accounting sources during report generation.
action_items: Optional maintainability: split backend/server.py into smaller modules (file is very large and high-risk for regressions).
Optional hardening: add lifecycle/cleanup policy for generated ERP PDF files in generated_reports directory if retention must be controlled.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py exceeds recommended size threshold (>700 lines), making review and regression isolation difficult.
ERP Health direct file endpoint is intentionally public (no auth) to satisfy direct-download requirement; keep explicit retention/governance in mind.
No MOCKED APIs were introduced in this scope.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on https://interest-calculator-12.preview.emergentagent.com using admin/social-solidarity. Backend: /api/bank-prints/banque-misr/external-data returns 404 after removal; /api/erp-health-report returns overall_score within 0-100, required metrics, recommendations, and direct_download_url; direct_download_url works publicly and returns application/pdf; /api/erp-health-report/pdf returns PDF with admin token; repeated report generation did not change journal_entries/reconciliations/trial-balance rows/bank opening balance in tested scope. Frontend: module-bank-prints-hub-card absent, module-erp-health-report-card present, /bank-prints and /bank-prints/banque-misr routes inactive (redirected), /erp-health-report displays score/metrics/recommendations/read-only note, and no impactful console errors were captured.
rca of the issue: No functional blocker found in requested scope. During UI automation, initial failures were test-script related (Eastern Arabic numeral assertion and wrong assumption that download link is nested anchor). The page uses Button asChild behavior where data-testid may be attached to the anchor element itself.
